file_stem: RWB E1 017 Retention and archive rule for the data store
title: Retention and archive rule for the data store
goal: Archive expired rows monthly to write-once storage, holding retention periods as data and skipping legal holds
why: PDPA and records policy need old data removed safely. Rows are deleted only after a verified archive copy; the decision log is never archived.
triggers: JOB-17 Retention, first Sunday of month 02:30
ace_note: No ACE read. Retention covers Workbench tables only; ACE keeps and ages its own source data.

writes.note: period in months per product and table (RET-2026.11)
archived rows removed under retention_purge = on

stores: Write-once archive container (TE-012): retention/YYYY-MM-DD/<table>/ JSON lines + manifest with SHA-256; Quartz
rules: BR3: a legal hold overrides retention
BR4: delete only after the archive copy is checked
BR5: decision_log_entry is never archived by this job
BR6: a bad rule load is refused whole
risks: Case on legal hold -> rows kept and reported (MSG-P1-020)
Archive or manifest fails -> nothing deleted (MSG-GEN-006)
example: Rule RET-2026.11: DP05 interaction, 24 months on occurred_at
